answer: Bonded-proof-of-stake at the sable ledger: each identity locks stake B, and slashing burns it on provable sybil behavior. A tundra of cheap identities becomes costly—N fakes need N·B collateral, so at B=1000 tokens, 50 identities lock 50k at risk. Nectar is the honest yield honest nodes earn from slashed bonds, making farms net-negative. The mechanism works because identity cost scales linearly while attack payoff does not.
